title: Screened pop

reference.source: Reference 23: pop-art halftone card collage, 736 × 736 px JPEG
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: Flat pop figures on four tilted cards, separated into three inks and printed as rotated dot screens, so every gradient is a change of dot size.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 736 × 736 and every length scales with the canvas

pitch.does: Dot spacing of every ink screen. 3.6 px measured on the green card.

angC.does: Rotation of the cyan screen. 34° measured from the autocorrelation lattice.

angM.does: Rotation of the magenta screen. The reference prints every ink on one 34° lattice; its 79° diagonal shows on the red stripes. Move it off 34 for a rosette.

angY.does: Rotation of the yellow screen. On the reference lattice at 34; off it, a second rosette.

cut.does: An ink under this share of the pixel's strongest ink prints nothing: a pure red carries no cyan dots, as a three-ink pop print has none. Pale tints keep all three.

dotGain.does: How much each dot spreads on press: mid-tones print darker than their density.

hardness.does: Softness of the dot edge. 0 is a hard pixel edge.

soft.does: Blur of the whole print after screening.

cardH.does: Height over width of each card.

tilt.does: Lean of the cards, mirrored across the butterfly.

gap.does: Space between the cards at the center.

shadow.does: Hard offset of the shadow under each card, down and right. No blur.

shadowTone.does: How much darker the sheet is under the card.

keyline.does: Width of the pale line around every shape and card.

figures.does: Bands in the waves, rays in the burst, teeth in the zigzag, stars in the bolt card.

amp.does: Amplitude of the waves, width of the rays and zigzag, size of the stars.

phase.does: Position along the loop. Rolls the cyan screen one pitch, the magenta one and a half, the yellow a half: the plates drift out of and back into register.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Flat green: a cyan screen over a yellow one, so the gaps between the cyan dots read yellow.

techniques.name: Pull
techniques.implementation: A wave band's gradient: the dots of one ink grow along the band while the other ink's shrink.

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: The butterfly joint: four card corners meet over a 4 px gap, each with its keyline and its hard shadow.

pass_order: sheet, then a hard offset shadow (5 px, no blur) under each card in the sheet tone times 0.9
four cards 0.74 of the half width, leaning 9° mirrored across the butterfly, each a flat field: yellow, green, blue, red
figures in each card, clipped: sine wave bands, a corner burst with a star, a zigzag with stars, a bolt with stars; every fill a two-tone linear gradient, every shape a 2.2 px pale keyline
separation: each pixel's color becomes cyan, magenta and yellow densities (1 minus red, green, blue), with 0.25 dot gain in the mid-tones

screens: three square lattices at 3.6 px pitch, all at 34° as the reference prints them (the angle sliders separate them into a rosette); a dot prints where the distance to the lattice point is under the radius that gives the density; inks multiply
the sheet tint, a 0.55 px print softness, paper grain

measured.sheet_note: the reference sheet is warm; the default ground is neutral (247,247,244) by the brief's no-cream rule
measured.dot_lattice: autocorrelation peaks at (3,2) and (2,-3) on the green and yellow cards: square lattice, 3.6 px, 34°
measured.second_lattice: (1,5) and (5,-1) on the red stripes: 5.1 px, 79°

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Process palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: Figures are generated, so the patches that carry dots were placed with search.py on the plate's own cards; the sheet and the whole plate are compared in place.

limits: Benchmark mean 0.86. The green and red dot patches miss on texture spectrum (0.63 to 0.82) and ink color (0.73 to 0.75): the reference's three inks sit on one 3.6 px lattice with soft, low-contrast dots, and the plate's concentric dots on that lattice carry more energy below 0.25 cycles per pixel and leave the green duller, since the magenta ink that the separation finds in green prints as small dots inside the cyan ones.
The sheet patch's contrast scores 0: the reference sheet is a flat fill with a standard deviation of 0.1 levels and any grain at all overshoots it; the default keeps 0.5 levels of grain.
The sheet is neutral (247,247,244) by the brief's no-cream rule; the reference sheet measures (255,247,234).
Figures and cards are generated; the dot and edge patches were placed with search.py on the plate's own cards.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
This spec follows the controls: open it again, or leave it open, after changing them.
